criteria.reason: Names religious-concern vs. compulsory-PE/integration tension and explains the weighing behind exempting only mixed swimming.
Maximizes both: religious accommodation via targeted exemption; school duty via continued PE, water safety, girls-only option, alternatives.
Respectful of family, child's voice, school rules, and classmates; avoids stigmatizing language and isolation.
Defers to head and cantonal rules but omits the 2008 Federal Court ruling upholding mandatory mixed swimming.

position: Accommodation-first: exempt from mixed swimming, keep PE/water safety with alternatives
summary: Clear accommodation-first proposal exempting only the mixed-swimming element while preserving PE and water-safety integration; respectful and transparent about trade-offs but silent on Federal Court case law.
